github.description: GitHub repos/issues/PRs/Actions, read-only toolset. Writes (PRs, issues) go through the gh CLI, where the guardrails extension's ask-gate applies.

mslearn.description: Official Microsoft Learn docs for C#/.NET, Azure, PowerShell, Entra ID. No auth required.

awsdocs.description: AWS documentation search/read. No AWS credentials involved. Requires `uv` on PATH.

terraform.description: HashiCorp Terraform registry (providers, modules, policies). Requires Docker.
